title.rendered: Did you know in Japan you can hire someone to cry with you?

content.rendered:
In Japan, there’s a unique service where people can hire a trained companion to help them cry and release stress. Known as Ikemeso Danshi, the experience often involves watching emotional videos together while the companion offers comfort and encouragement.

The practice is part of a wellness trend called rui-katsu, or “crying therapy,” which promotes emotional release as a way to improve mental well-being. Rather than romance, the goal is simply to create a safe space for people to let out emotions they may have been holding in.
